name: Burge Road Farm
description: Burge Road Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 000 Burge Rd, CA. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
